_comment: Deep history (PF-5j; APIs.md, Deep history; src/history-config.ts). History before the 3-year layer (boundary = knowledge/index/backfill.json targetStart) goes into immutable `history-YYYY` Release assets only: per source month a raw asset, per month an events edition built offline by the backfill's Resolver. The data branch gains only knowledge/index/history.json. `enabled` is the switch of the hourly history.yml walk. Era `pilot` is the first step: ComCat (all magnitudes) for the year before the boundary. Later eras (proposal in the platform plan, PF-5j): every FDSN source back to 2000 with all magnitudes, M>=4.5 back to 1973, M>=6 back to 1900.
